3MBXB-5HIHX-XNAS6-BBO0I.text:
[Log A-01 | Stardate 2387.119.1719]
CAPTAIN’S LOG -- DAY 1 -- SURVEY VESSEL

Day one. We are underway.
 
Crew of fourteen. All in good spirits. This should be a
routine survey mission -- eight months out, eight months back.
 
The anomaly the probe flagged is probably a rogue planet.
 
Probably.

    —— Capt. E. Harrow

3WQCB-X4KOU-XMV4E-KA800.text:
[Log A-15 | Stardate 2387.136.2132]
CAPTAIN’S LOG -- DAY 18 -- SURVEY VESSEL

Dr. Osei submitted a supplemental sensor report today.
 
The anomaly's gravitational signature does not match
any catalogued body type.
 
I asked what that means.
 
She said she didn't know yet.
 
I told her to keep looking.

    —— Capt. E. Harrow
